name: Query Order Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the inquiry status of order.

QUCO.name: Query Unconfirmed Order
QUCO.definition: Query for orders which are not confirmed by a party.

QOFP.name: Query Orders For The Party
QOFP.definition: Query for all orders for a party.

QFEO.name: Query Fully Executed Order
QFEO.definition: Query for orders have been completely executed.

QPEO.name: Query Partially Executed Order
QPEO.definition: Query for orders have been partially executed.
